Payment method

M-Pesa ···· 4821 and Visa ···· 4417 on file. Payments are taken on the first working day of each month and receipted immediately.

Cancelling removes your listings the same day. There is no notice period and no commission is owed on a sale in progress.

Moderation

How our review keeps the verified badge meaningful

Title and authority

We run an official lands search and confirm the person listing is the registered owner or has written authority.

Physical inspection

A surveyor photographs and measures the property. Listings are measured, not taken on trust.

Ongoing checks

Listings that stay live are re-checked every six months. Sold or withdrawn listings come down the same day.
